name: X-Road
description: X-Road is an open-source data exchange layer enabling secure, standardized digital communication between organizations and government systems. Developed by NIIS a joint body of Estonia and Finland it underpins national e-governance infrastructure and is adopted by governments worldwide.

owner.name: NIIS Nordic Institute for Interoperability Solutions
owner.description: Joint body of Estonia and Finland developing interoperability solutions for public sector digital infrastructure.
